kjv: I saw gods ascending out of the earth
mine: I see a divine being coming up out of the earth
note: Hebrew elohim with a plural participle (olim) can mean "gods" or a single supernatural being; Saul's follow-up "What does he look like?" shows one figure is meant, so "gods" misleads. Context: a divine being (high confidence). 28:14 Saul asks 'What is his appearance?' and is told 'an old man is coming up': one figure.
